PLAN "Couch to 5K – 12 Weeks (EIA-aware)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "complete a 5K run in 12 weeks safely with progressive walk-run intervals and proper warmups"

PHASES
  PHASE "Base Conditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "W1D1 Walk-Run Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 8x1..2 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "W1D2 Walk-Run Intro":
